g.text: KayaRank4Convo2 begins.
Nova?
Nova?
Kaya?
None of us would ever judge you.
What happened to you is a complete personal violation.
Someone violated your trust and tried to humiliate you.
You were vulnerable and you were betrayed.
Your world was pulled from under you.
People looked at you differently.
Do you see why I need to get away?
It's like, what happened to me had never happened to ANYONE.
It made headlines. People mocked me for pretending I was a victim of something when it was my own choice to share that photo.
You can't even look up my name in the student databases without people thinking of that 'STP', Slutty Teachers Pet.
And you guys will find the picture too and none of you will ever look at me the same again. Like any respect... gone. Forever
I have to get out, I have to move forward, to a time and place where I was smart enough to leave this all behind.
There's nothing more for me to say. We've all done things we regret.
If anything I respect you more.
There will never be a moment where any of us judge you for this.
Maybe one day you can tell me the biggest regret you have...
Don't F*** Lie to me.
Check boolean KayaEternalismTest
Maybe I will. We have lots of time, after all.
It's a promise. You're not alone in this world. We're all just taking chances on other people.
Not a lie. Just believe it. [End.]
Hear me out.
You obviously figured out Eternalism, maybe better than I did.
true
Check boolean KayaAttitude
false
+20 Chemistry
Update boolean KayaPromiseRegret
+20 Chemistry
Which is saying something.
All that attitude you've given me? At least it makes sense, you were afraid AND angry. I was another stranger on the internet.
true
I will never talk you out of leaving 1999.
false
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank4Convo3.
+20 Chemistry
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank4Convo3.
I'm sure there's a way. And it means more to you to go somewhere else, anywhere else.
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank4Convo3.
Help is always here. I might be a better listener than time traveler, though. Don't be shy.
+20 Chemistry
